reason: E1 and E2 show that cryo-rolling plus annealing enhances strength-ductility synergy in specific HEAs via hierarchical microstructures, but neither involves the target alloy nor addresses caloric performance; the premise that caloric response is preserved is entirely unsupported by cited evidence.
premises: Cryo-rolling plus annealing can create a hierarchical nano-lamellar microstructure in HEAs
Such a microstructure enhances strength-ductility synergy in brittle intermetallic-containing HEAs
The hierarchical microstructure obstructs crack propagation and distributes stress
The processing does not interfere with reversible phase transformations responsible for caloric effects
The specific alloy (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 will respond similarly to the cited HEA systems
